beats.event: Qays meets Layla at school; they fall in scandalous love
He sings love poems in public and is nicknamed Majnun, the mad
Layla's family sequester her; his father seeks her hand
Layla's father refuses, unwilling to wed her to a madman
Majnun rends his clothes and flees to the desert
His father takes him to the Kaaba; he prays only for more love
Layla is forced into marriage with the wealthy Ibn Salam
Majnun lives among wild animals in the wilderness
The Bedouin prince Nawfal wages battle to win Layla for him, and fails
The lovers exchange poems and letters through messengers
Majnun's parents die while he remains estranged in the desert
Ibn Salam dies of grief, having never consummated the marriage
The lovers briefly reunite through song, not touch
Layla sickens and dies, buried in her wedding dress
Majnun comes to her grave and dies upon it
The two are buried together, united in death
